summary: Re-review of B1 at 1572612. The scope is the one text commit ee48a25 (range 1572612..ee48a25, plan.md and spec.md only) plus the two driver files outside the repo. The ruling holds end to end. The drivers probe-4.10.sh and night-4.11.sh export BENCH_RA_QUOTA=/home/daniebo/Desktop/advantage-pr/scripts/jobs/ra-quota and RA_QUOTA_LASTGOOD=/tmp/ra-quota-lastgood.json (probe lines 16-17, night lines 16-17), and quota.ts reads those exact names (BENCH_RA_QUOTA at quota.ts:408, RA_QUOTA_LASTGOOD at quota.ts:315). ra-quota honors the same RA_QUOTA_LASTGOOD override for its last-good write (ra-quota:1323-1332), so writer and reader share one file, and its config holds the plan id opencode-go with thresholds 5h 95 / weekly 100. Every claim in the new plan row Point 8 text (plan.md:2397) matches the code and the drivers: quota.ts keeps no default path, the ra-quota read is `timeout 90 ra-quota status --json` (equals RA_QUOTA_TIMEOUT_MS 90_000, quota.ts:88), the tool reads .["opencode-go"].windows percents, requires usable 5h and weekly, applies the 95/100 thresholds (quota.ts:69,78), and stops on a stale (>= 6 h, quota.ts:91) or missing last-good reading. Spec D15 (spec.md:752-756) and FR-15 (spec.md:1344) state the same facts. heavy-run.sh passes the environment through (run_cmd executes the command directly, the flock re-exec inherits the parent env, and the systemd-run scope unsets only the DBUS addresses), the jobs folder holds only the two drivers, and the other nightly entry (harness/cron-daily.sh) never calls the model_guide runners. No living plan or spec text claims a default ra-quota path; the remaining matches are historical run artifacts. The drivers' own Go check uses the same thresholds as quota.ts (five >= 95 or week >= 100, probe:77, night:92). One nonblocking gap: the row 4.13 judge calls of the Go judge route run from the orchestrator session, not from the drivers, and no text names BENCH_RA_QUOTA for them.
